name: dsh-tool-metaforge
description: DSH MetaForge - self-generating plugin factory. Auto-generates scaffolding, validates TypeScript, generates cordis.yml/package.json/tsconfig.json from templates, produces documentation blocks, creates conventional commit messages, scores plugin quality, and configures batch generation runs. The L6 autonomous layer that makes the entire DSH plugin toolkit self-sustaining.
author: chengganping-ship-it
